hero.headline:
The future of AI.
Starts with people.
hero.subtext: We’re Tal and Roei. Turning curiosity about AI into understanding, hands-on experience and practical work, through talks, workshops and personal guidance.

about.text: AI Finance grew out of finance and accounting. We help finance departments, accounting firms, and accounting and payroll professionals in Israel move from general discussion of AI to practical work through workshops, executive lectures and process mapping for initial pilots. Our professional community of more than 2,000 finance professionals connects us each week to real questions, tasks and challenges. This helps us build content and activities around financial work itself, in accessible language and with room for professional oversight.

faq.question: Who is the AI Finance community for?
faq.answer: The community is for accountants, controllers, payroll professionals, bookkeepers, FP&A professionals, analysts, finance managers and people working in budgeting, audit and controls. It is for anyone who wants to understand how AI can fit into financial and accounting work in a practical, professional way.

faq.question: What do community members receive?
faq.answer: Members receive weekly professional content, guides, templates and examples of using AI in finance, accounting and payroll. We filter the flood of updates and focus on tools and capabilities that can support work with Excel, reports, documents, controls, data analysis, budgets and recurring processes.

faq.question: Do I need a technical background to join?
faq.answer: No. The community grew out of finance and accounting, and content is explained in professional, accessible language for people without a technology background too. All you need is curiosity and a desire to explore how AI can fit into your work.

faq.question: How do I join the community?
faq.answer: Join directly through the AI Finance WhatsApp group, with no form to complete. Once you join, you can receive content, guides and updates as part of the community’s ongoing activities.

faq.question: Who are AI Finance services for?
faq.answer: Our services are for finance departments, accounting firms, leadership teams, and accounting and payroll professionals, including FP&A, controllership, audit and bookkeeping teams. They suit both beginners and organizations or firms already using tools and seeking to expand their use.

faq.question: Which fits us: a lecture, a workshop or process mapping?
faq.answer: A lecture suits leadership teams and teams wanting to understand opportunities, risks and possible uses. A workshop suits teams wanting to practice with tools on finance, accounting and payroll tasks. Process mapping suits an organization or firm seeking practical uses and a foundation for a pilot that can be tested, measured and expanded. In a short introductory conversation, we will identify what fits your needs together.

faq.question: Is the content tailored to our team and tasks?
faq.answer: Yes. We start with the tasks your team performs, its knowledge level, the tools available in your organization or firm, and the constraints that matter. This keeps activities connected to everyday work rather than general examples of AI.

faq.question: Do workshops include hands-on practice?
faq.answer: Yes. Workshops include familiar finance and accounting tasks such as report analysis, Excel work, document summaries, producing deliverables, controls and recurring processes. The aim is to help participants learn the tools and understand how to start integrating them into their work.

faq.question: How do you address information security and human oversight?
faq.answer: Alongside AI capabilities, we cover limitations, risks and the need for professional oversight. Activities address information that should not be uploaded to public tools, reviewing outputs and situations where professional judgment remains essential.
